author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value:
To address Tupper's comment on the developer stream directly ( https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2750638358?t=01h31m43s >"...or lessen the security capabilities of eac on virtual machines which we also cannot do" )

the current method to play on *any* virtual machine solution is to spoof many devices in the system to appear as real hardware via hacks and patches. This is not a "security" thing VMs get wrong, this is simply necessary evasion when an application is trying to block the execution in virtual machines. I am still very much interested in a direct addressing of whether or not VRC can simply no longer try to detect and block VMs.

details:
The important thing is not that it does not work in a VM. DO NOT merge there.
What is this doing until it becomes a file driver? Why doesn't the easiest way to find out for sure work?
title: DO NOT block the way to promise security of our computres
